answers.core: Godot 3 had a feature to ignore all warnings using comments. I think it would be natural for this to not be an addon as it was a feature that was removed in Godot 4 when the warning system moved from comments to annotations.
answers.workaround: Depends on the Singleton. In my singleton, I'm using 23 signals, so right now I have 23 `@warning_ignore("unused_signal")`. As you can see in the previous point, it's really cumbersome.
